profile.headline: Front-end | JavaScript | PHP | Adobe Analytics | Technical SEO | Developer
profile.summary: Detail-oriented and seasoned Front End and WordPress Developer with over five years of hands-on experience, specializing in creating visually appealing and highly functional websites. Adept at implementing responsive design principles, ensuring optimal user experiences across various devices. Proven expertise in accessibility standards and SEO best practices and proficiency in MySQL database management. I seek a challenging role where my technical skills and creative flair can contribute to developing cutting-edge web solutions.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
•	Familiar with UI / UX best practices, accessibility, and usability.	
•	Strong front-end development skills: HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript (jQuery).
•	Collaborated with project managers and business stakeholders to review business requirements and understand functional specifications to create technical design requirements.
•	Developed software to implement front-end designs to business needs and expectations (Plugin Development).
•	Built layouts that looked great in multiple browsers.
•	Expanded CMS tools to meet business needs.(i.e., WordPress and Hybris/SAP (SmartEdit)).
•	Created layouts with CSS frameworks (i.e., Twitter Bootstrap, Foundation, and Bulma).
•	Updated page designs with pre-processor language LESS  and Sass.
•	Implemented page and click reporting application WebTrends and Adobe Launch.
•	Maintained WordPress and BluJay projects with PHP.
•	Built a staging server running a LAMP stack.
•	Maintain an SAP site with MVC framework Spring.
•	Experienced with Git, CLI (Terminal), and build tools (grunt, gulp, and webpack).

positions.title: Support Technician
positions.description:
•	Provided exceptional customer service at all times.
•	Answered incoming calls/emails for IT-related support in a timely manner.
•	Consistently managed tickets in team and personal queue.
•	Provided regular updates to customers on open ticket status and progress.
•	Clearly documented issue description, troubleshooting steps and resolution details in each support ticket.
•	Performed on-site desk-side support and IT equipment moves as necessary.
•	Organized meeting room AV setup and instructed users on equipment operation.
•	Performed computer and hardware asset imaging, deployment, maintenance and tracking.
•	Involvement in testing operating systems, applications and hardware.
•	Completed various project-related work.

positions.title: Technical Assistant
positions.description:
•	Provided IT Support for 120+ on-site local users.
•	Managed multiple Apple Computer Labs
•	Managed computer and user accounts via Active Directory.
•	Administered Apple Server
•	Managed Print and File Share Servers.
•	Active Directory and Open Directory experience.
•	Supported Teachers with Instructional Technology (i.e. smartboards, smart tables, etc.)
•	Integrated AD / OD services.
•	Configured and Managed Scripting Solution Desktop Authority.
•	Managed iOS devices through Profile Manager.

company.name: University School of Nova Southeastern University

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
•	Created responsive layouts using: HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript.
•	Improved the core vitals of clients’ websites to improve page load performance by over 10%.
•	Developed apps to process REST services built with AJAX/ XML / JSON.
•	Developed PHP forms to collect and sanitize data before processing (i.e., email or interact with MySQL(CRUD)).
•	Configured a LAMP stack from a vanilla EC2 instance.
•	Implemented package managers like NPM, Yarn, and Composer to manage dependencies.
•	Configured task runners/bundlers like Grunt, Gulp, Webpack, and Vite.
•	Developed responsive layouts with the CSS framework tailwindcss.
positions.insights: Skills: Front-end Development · JavaScript · AJAX · jQuery · SASS · Laravel · PHP · Wordpress Development · Doctrine (PHP) · Tailwind CSS · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)

positions.title: Support Specialist/ Support Specialist Lead
positions.description:
•    Provided IT Support for 100+ users on-site and 2000+ users nationwide.
•    Handled tickets with Remote Assistance tools, phone, and email communication.
•    Documented all incidents in database.
•    Supervised a shift of technicians.
•    Processed Daily Shift Reports.

positions.title: Banquet Server/ Supervisor
positions.description:
Orchestrate Banquet Operations.
    Primarily responsible for the success of assigned Catering Events.  Includes setting up and breaking down of event area. 

Assisted with the location of seats for guests.

company.name: Boston Culinary Group at Dolphins Stadium

positions.title: ADSL Installation Technician
positions.description:
•	Installed and maintained Bellsouth ADSL service for customers.
•	Logged ADSL signal parameters, installed cat 5e cables and phone jacks.
•	Constructed Small Business and Home networks with wireless security.
•	Worked together with other IT Directors to configure Bellsouth routers to match with current LAN settings.
